# `ability`

Something a character has and can use: a skill, a spell, a power, a gift (08 §3). Actions it makes available with their costs and cooldowns, what it confers while active, modes that are switched on and off, a rank and parameters.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `description` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a closer look says of it.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): What it is, for suppression, counters, filters and rules that care.
- `seat` (one of `"body"`, `"mind"` ([`Seat`](#seat)); optional): `body` or `mind`: which it stays with when they part (06 §8.2).
- `track` (id of a [`track`](track.md), or `null`; optional): The track whose level is its rank. Left out, the rank is set when it is granted and changed by `set_rank`.
- `rank` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The rank it is granted at when it has no track and the grant gives none. Default 1.
- `params` (object, name → [expression of number](../values.md#expressions); optional): Named numbers its actions and traits read, as `ability.<name>`: expressions with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`, worked out when they are read, then modified.
- `always` ([`Always`](#always); optional): What it confers while active.
- `grants` (list of [`AbilityGrantDef`](#abilitygrantdef); optional): The actions it makes available.
- `modes` (list of object [`ModeDef`](#modedef); optional): Sustained states it can be switched into.
- `while` ([condition](../values.md#conditions), or `null`; optional): A reactive condition (05 §7.5) about the owner: while it is false the ability is dormant and confers nothing.
- `rules` (list of [`eoc`](eoc.md), by id or [written in place](../values.md#inline-definitions); optional): Rules attached to the owner while the ability is active (05 §9.3).

<a id="seat"></a>
### `Seat`

Which goes where when a mind and a body part company (06 §8.2).

One of:

- `"body"`: Stays with the body.
- `"mind"`: Leaves with the mind.

<a id="always"></a>
### `Always`

`always`: one set of what is conferred, or a list of them each from its own rank.

Written as what is conferred, or a list of such.

Takes:

- an object: object [`AlwaysDef`](#alwaysdef)
- a list: list of object [`AlwaysDef`](#alwaysdef)

<a id="abilitygrantdef"></a>
### `AbilityGrantDef`

An action an ability makes available to its owner (08 §5.1).

In data: an action's id, or `{ "action": id, "params": { name: expression }, "cost": { … }, "cooldown": time, "at_rank": int, "if": condition, "intent": word, "value": expression }`.

Written as an action's id, or a grant with an `action`.

Takes:

- a string: id of a [`action`](action.md)
- an object: object [`GrantObject`](#grantobject)

<a id="modedef"></a>
### `ModeDef`

A state an ability can be switched into (08 §5.4): an aura, a stance of power, a transformation, flight.

- `id` (string; **required**): Its name within the ability: lowercase letters, digits and `_`.
- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `at_rank` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The least rank it can be switched on at.
- `trait` (string, or `null`; optional): The trait it gives while on, as written.
- `upkeep` (object, id of a [`pool`](pool.md) → [expression of number](../values.md#expressions); optional): What it drains while on, per second of the owner's time, by pool: an expression with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`, worked out when it is switched on.
- `cost` (object, name → [`CostDef`](#costdef); optional): What switching it on spends.
- `uses` (object, id of a [`channel`](channel.md) → whole number, 0 or more; optional): Channel slots it holds while on (03 §6.2). Carried: a mode's trait disables slots with its `channels` meanwhile.
- `on_start` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run as it comes on, with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`.
- `on_end` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): Effects run as it ends, however it ends.
- `look` (string, or `null`; optional): How its owner appears while it is on (12 §4.4), as written.

<a id="alwaysdef"></a>
### `AlwaysDef`

What an ability confers on its owner while it is active (08 §3.1): from a rank up, if `at_rank` says.

- `at_rank` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The least rank this applies from.
- `traits` (list of string; optional): Traits given, with the instance as their giver.
- `modifiers` (list of object [`ModifierDef`](#modifierdef); optional): Attribute modifiers, under the instance as their source.
- `params` (list of object [`ParamModifierDef`](#parammodifierdef); optional): Changes to the parameters of abilities: of this one or others.
- `senses` (list of string; optional): Senses added or altered (15), as written. Carried until perception reads them.

<a id="grantobject"></a>
### `GrantObject`

A grant written as an object: the action, with what the ability supplies and asks of using it.

- `action` (id of a [`action`](action.md); optional): The action the ability makes available. Required.
- `params` (object, name → [expression](../values.md#expressions); optional): Parameters of the action the ability supplies, by name: expressions with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`. They stand in for whatever a command gives under the same names.
- `cost` (object, name → [`CostDef`](#costdef); optional): What starting it spends, by the pool it is paid from or the item consumed (08 §5.2).
- `cooldown` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): Seconds of the owner's own time before it can be used again: an expression with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`.
- `at_rank` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): The least rank of the ability it needs.
- `if` ([condition](../values.md#conditions), or `null`; optional): A further condition, in the owner's mind: what it believes, its own state and the instance.
- `intent` (one of `"harm"`, `"protect"`, `"escape"`, `"control"`, `"aid"`, `"utility"` ([`Intent`](#intent)), or `null`; optional): A hint to whoever chooses for a character: what using it is for.
- `value` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): A score of a use, for choosers that cannot preview it (08 §11). Carried for the AI layer.

<a id="costdef"></a>
### `CostDef`

One cost of a grant or a mode (08 §5.2), keyed in data by the pool it is paid from, or by the item consumed when `item` is true.

In data: an amount (a number or an expression), or `{ "amount": …, "overdraw": { "from": pool, "ratio": 2.0 }, "from": "…" }` for a pool, or `{ "item": true, "count": 1 }` for items.

Written as an amount, or a cost with `amount` or `item`.

Takes:

- a string: [expression of number](../values.md#expressions)
- an object: object [`CostObject`](#costobject)
- an integer: [expression of number](../values.md#expressions)
- a number: [expression of number](../values.md#expressions)

<a id="modifierdef"></a>
### `ModifierDef`

An attribute modifier an item confers on whoever holds it in a grasp or wears it (06 §9.1, §4.1).

- `attr` (id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md); **required**): The attribute.
- `add` (number; optional): Added to the attribute's base. Default 0.
- `mul` (number; optional): Multiplied in after every addition. Default 1.

<a id="parammodifierdef"></a>
### `ParamModifierDef`

A change to a parameter of abilities (08 §4.2), made by whatever lists it while that lasts: a trait (its `ability_params`) or an active ability (its `always`). It names one ability or a tag, never both, and one parameter.

- `ability` (string, or `null`; optional): The ability whose parameter it changes, as written.
- `tag` (string, or `null`; optional): Or: every ability with this tag.
- `param` (string; **required**): The parameter.
- `add` (number; optional): Added to the parameter's value. Default 0.
- `mul` (number; optional): Multiplied in after every addition. Default 1.

<a id="intent"></a>
### `Intent`

What an ability's grant is for, as a hint to whoever chooses for a character (08 §11; 09 §6.1). The engine reads nothing into it.

One of:

- `"harm"`: It hurts someone.
- `"protect"`: It shields someone.
- `"escape"`: It gets its user away.
- `"control"`: It makes someone do or not do something.
- `"aid"`: It helps someone.
- `"utility"`: Anything else.

<a id="costobject"></a>
### `CostObject`

A cost written as an object: an amount from a pool, with where a shortfall is made up and who pays, or an item consumed.

- `amount` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): How much, for a pool: an expression with the owner as `self` and the instance as `ability`.
- `overdraw` (object [`OverdrawDef`](#overdrawdef), or `null`; optional): Where a shortfall is made up from, if it may be: `{ "from": pool, "ratio": 2.0 }`.
- `from` ([expression](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): Who pays in the owner's place: an expression that gives an entity, such as something bound to the ability (08 §7.3). Left out, the owner pays.
- `item` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether the key names an item consumed rather than a pool. Default false.
- `count` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): For an item: how many are consumed. Default 1.

<a id="overdrawdef"></a>
### `OverdrawDef`

Where a cost the owner cannot meet may be made up (08 §5.2): what is missing is taken from another pool at a ratio.

- `from` (id of a [`pool`](pool.md); optional): The pool that makes up the shortfall.
- `ratio` (number; optional): How much of it each missing unit costs. Default 1.
